The integrity of the downloads is verified using hardcoded SHA-256 checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, which is a secure practice.

The package installs the binary, desktop file, icon, terminfo entry, documentation, and license files to standard system directories using `install`, which is consistent with Arch Linux packaging guidelines. The `options` array disables debug info and stripping, which is acceptable for a binary-only package where source compilation is not performed.

All operations are transparent, reproducible, and confined to the build and package environment. The maintainer follows standard AUR practices, and there is no evidence of obfuscation, data exfiltration, or execution of downloaded code. The package does not modify system files outside its scope or introduce backdoors.

No scripts or build instructions are present in this file — it only describes the source and metadata. All content aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for a precompiled binary distribution.
